name: Lost Girl
source:
Sarah dissapeared that night. 

They looked for her, but it was too late, death had done it before.

[From [url=https://gaelrdrgz.itch.io/lost-girl]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
那天晚上，Sarah失踪了。

他们四处寻找她，却为时已晚，死神已经先一步找到了她。
